Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about the latency gains you showed. We're preparing the internal paperwork to start the 6-week POC, but our procurement group is asking whether a Purchase Order will be required to invoice Redwood for the pilot.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — we'd like to start the week of Oct 25.

Hi Mike — great to hear, and glad the demo landed.

Short answer: our default is PO-required for any vendor onboarding that will result in invoicing, but we do have a temporary invoice-only exception process for short pilots and small-dollar engagements. I'm looping in Priyom (procurement) and Marissa from operations to propose workable guardrails.

Marissa — if we can get an exception, we should onboard SparrowTech with the conditional tag so billing knows the pilot is invoice-only and capped. Priyom, can procurement propose terms (cap, duration, evidence) so we can confirm to SparrowTech today?

Subject: Re: PO mandate for upcoming pilot with Redwood

Hi all — procurement here. We can approve a temporary invoice-only path for SparrowTech's POC under the following conditional checklist: 

• Duration: 60 days (from first invoice)
• Spend cap: $50,000 total across the POC period
• Evidence required before onboarding: signed SOW, completed vendor intake (W-9 or local equivalent), and PI/contracting point of contact
• Billing cadence: SparrowTech to submit a single consolidated invoice at the end of the POC; Ops will not process partial invoices without prior approval
• Risk controls: set vendor account flag "invoice-only-conditional" and require manual approval for any invoice that would exceed 80% of cap
• Rollback: If the vendor intends to continue beyond the pilot or exceeds cap, a standard PO must be issued and normal onboarding will be enforced

Attached is the internal checklist we use for these exceptions (temp_no_po_checklist.pdf). Once we have the completed intake + SOW we will sign off and provide a DocuSign link for a brief exception acknowledgement.

Marissa — please create the onboarding ticket and tag finance with the conditional flag.

Mike — can you confirm SparrowTech accepts these terms and attach the completed intake? If you prefer, we can shorten the cap for an earlier approval.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Manager
